blocks.title: Isomers
blocks.text: Do ya do se zyada compounds jin ka molecular formula aik ho lekin atoms ka arrangement (tarteeb) aur properties alag hon, isomers kehlate hain, aur is cheez ko isomerism kehte hain.
Organic compounds mein isomerism do alag wajahon se paida hoti hai:

items: Jab do ya zyada molecules mein wahi groups ya atoms alag alag jagahon par jure hon, to structural ya constitutional isomerism hoti hai. Yeh type Chemistry 11 mein parhi ja chuki hai.
Jab isomers mein substituents ya groups ka space mein arrangement (spatial arrangement) alag ho, to kehte hain ke un ki configuration alag hai. Is type ko stereoisomerism kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Isomers (aik molecular formula) do mein: Constitutional (connectivity alag): i. Chain, ii. Position, iii. Functional, iv. Metamers, v. Tautomers; aur Stereoisomers (connectivity wahi, space mein orientation alag). Stereoisomers: bond tore baghair rotation (gardish) se badalte hain? No: Configurational; Yes: Conformational. Configurational: rotation ruki hui? No: Optical; Yes: Geometrical. Optical: mirror image par na baithne wali? Yes: Enantiomers; No: Diastereomers.
blocks.caption: Isomers ki classification (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chart ko oopar se neeche sawalon ki tarah parhein. Har shaakh par aik sawal likha hai aur us ke do jawab hain: Yes ya No. Maslan stereoisomers par sawal hai: kya yeh sirf single bond ke ghoomne se, koi bond tore baghair, aik doosre mein badal jate hain? Haan to conformational (jaise butane ki shakalein), nahi to configurational. Phir poocha jata hai ke rotation ruka hua (restricted, jaise C=C par) hai ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: Ethanol aur methoxymethane dono C₂H₆O hain. Yeh kis type ke isomers hain?
blocks.explanation: Constitutional (structural) isomers, khaas taur par functional group isomers: aik alcohol hai aur aik ether.

items: Isomers: molecular formula aik, atoms ka arrangement aur properties alag.
Constitutional isomers: atoms alag jagah jure hain. Stereoisomers: connectivity wahi, space mein arrangement alag.
